notes.text: Codification Section 471, act Mar. 4, 1927, ch. 513, § 1, 44 Stat. 1452, which declared Congressional policy towards grazing districts and privileges, was transferred to section 316 of Title 43, Public Lands. Section 471a, act Mar. 4, 1927, ch. 513, § 2, 44 Stat. 1452, which defined terms “person”, “district”, “Secretary”, and “lessee”, was transferred to section 316a of Title 43. Section 471b, act Mar. 4, 1927, ch. 513, § 3, 44 Stat. 1452, which gave the Secretary the power to establish grazing districts, was transferred to section 316b of Title 43. Section 471c, act Mar. 4, 1927, ch. 513, § 4, 44 Stat. 1452, which provided for the alteration of grazing district, was transferred to section 316c of Title 43. Section 471d, act Mar. 4, 1927, ch. 513, § 5, 44 Stat. 1453, which provided for the giving of notice of the establishment of grazing districts, was transferred to section 316d of Title 43. Section 471e, act Mar. 4, 1927, ch. 513, § 6, 44 Stat. 1453, which authorized the giving of preferences in considering the applications to lease grazing lands, was transferred to section 316e of Title 43.
